character: Also called Courchevel 1550. Quiet, residential village slightly removed from the main centre. More authentic than 1850, less sleepy than Le Praz. Good-value accommodation. Convenient access to Moriond and 1850 via free shuttle.
dining: L'Oeil de Boeuf. La Cortona (Italian, wood-fired pizza). Small selection of restaurants.
shopping: Basic convenience shops, ski rental. Limited retail.
apres_scene: Quiet. Catérail bar near new Grangettes gondola.
activities_nearby: Access to 600km Trois Vallées. Hiking. Free shuttle to all Courchevel levels. 4-min gondola to 1850 from Grangettes.
